scalars.scalar_value: Experience in Donor Relations, including donor database management, creating stewardship plans and impact reports and coordinating donor events

items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?

02. Please describe your hands-on experience with supporting the preparation and delivery of a donor impact report (or similar external client communication.) In your response, detail a specific instance that demonstrates your experience with databases and systems, attention to detail, and processes: 1. Provide a profile or short background on the donor (or client) and their gift interests. 2. Describe the specific information you gathered (e.g., gift amounts, project metrics), and how did verify that the information was accurate before preparing the report? 3. What CRM or database tools did you use and specifically how did you log, tag, or update the donor record and communication history once the report was finalized? 4. What platforms or tools did you use to format or assemble the report to match your organization's standards? 5. What administrative touchpoints did you coordinate to support the delivery (e.g., paper or electronic mailing, scheduling follow-up reminders, or filing receipts/acknowledgements)?

03. Please describe a specific instance where you provided end-to-end administrative support for a non profit board of directors meeting cycle, from agenda preparation to post-meeting archiving (or similar governing body or committee). In your response, detail your specific operational and logistics responsibilities across these four areas: 1. Describe the timelines and processes you followed to communication meeting details to members, noting whether the meetings adhered to the Brown Act or any other public meeting rules. 2. What specific process or software did you use to compile the various reports? How did you handle version control to ensure attendees received accurate materials? 3. How did you handle pre-meeting logistics such as tracking RSVPs for quorum, managing hybrid/AV setup, or gathering signed conflict-of-interest disclosures? 4. Describe your hands-on role during the meeting itself. How did you capture official minutes, track specific motions/votes, and separate confidential notes (such as executive session topics) from standard public or board records? 5. What specific administrative steps did you take within 48 to 72 hours after the meeting concluded (e.g., routing resolutions for signatures, updating governance files, distributing action-item trackers to staff leads)?
04. This is a transfer recruitment open to current Coast Community College District employees who have expressed interest. Please list your employee ID and current position.

05. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses are required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

06. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
